summary: Built an isolated preserve-first Calendar/Habits/Money candidate that removes the fixed Habits roster as runtime authority. Tracker configuration is user-configurable (add, rename, classify, archive, restore), uses stable tracker ids, migrates only ids actually observed in existing behavior history, keeps archived trackers recoverable/exportable, neutralizes legacy sample seeding for genuinely new users, and keeps behavior-event persistence on the existing v31 IndexedDB + mirror/outbox path. Tracker metadata is canonical in PrometeoDB meta when available with a localStorage mirror fallback. No Catalog, Current, Human Accepted, Served, CAL001 or gh-pages product pointer was changed.
